description: This file defines the MarkBased class, which extends RegexBasedAbstract, and is part of the FastRoute DataGenerator namespace. It appears to handle route data generation using marked regex chunks.

classes.name: MarkBased
classes.description: A class that extends RegexBasedAbstract to generate route data using regex chunks marked with labels.

methods.name: getApproxChunkSize
methods.description: Returns an approximate chunk size, hardcoded to 30.

methods.name: processChunk
methods.description: Processes a map of regex to route objects, appends marks to regexes, and builds a combined regex pattern with labeled chunks.
